synopsis.text: Alias’ pulse-pounding conclusion! Jessica’s past with Jean Grey revealed. Plus, Marvel’s top P.I. has been harboring a secret- one that she can’t keep from Scott Lang or Luke Cage for much longer! The end of the Purple Man saga. Will Jessica exact the revenge Killgrave deserves?

The continuation of the Purple Man saga with Jessica Jones ends here. First we see Purple Man torturing her, playing with her mind, making her see and do things she doesn't want to. He makes her walk down the street with him and for entertainment he makes the people on a crowded street riot and fight each other to the death. Just then Jean Grey appears to Jessica as a psychic projection. She informs Jessica that after the first encounter she had with Purple Man that put her in a coma she implanted within her a psychic trigger defense when she helped her out of the coma. So now she knows she has the power to end this. When the Avengers show up Purple Man explains that he kidnapped her and brought her out to make her fight her friends and kill one of the Avengers. However at that point she's already broken his hold on her. He tells her to go and break Captain America's back but she doesn't. She tries to break his instead.
Later she breaks things off with Scott Lang (Ant-Man) and Cage finally tells her how he actually feels about her and they begin their real relationship.
